description: Corrections to the working edition (data.json), applied by the converter (tools/nle.py apply_note_moves) and by tools/check_edition.js. noteMoves: footnotes the working edition attached to the neighbouring section on a shared page. Each names the note by its section and index in data.json (cont: continuation notes that go with it), its mark, and the section whose call it answers. Read from the MDZ scans (bsb10725331, bsb10725332) by Claude Sonnet, one reader per run of sections; only answers the reader marked certain and whose two sections share a printed page are applied.
